businesses.business: mobile app advertising and distribution platforms

offering_description.value: Sells mobile app advertising, app monetization software and app preload distribution to app developers, advertisers, mobile carriers and device makers. Earns fees from ad campaigns, per-install payments and preloading apps on phones.

primary_products.value: mobile advertising platform; app monetization software; app preload software

primary_services.value: app user acquisition campaigns; app distribution programs; ad mediation

customer_segment.value: B2B: app developers, advertisers, mobile carriers, smartphone device makers

end_markets.value: mobile gaming; mobile apps; digital advertising; telecommunications; consumer electronics

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: ad revenue share and per-install fees paid by advertisers and developers; service fees: fees for preloading and distributing apps on carrier and device makers' phones
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: ad exchange and monetization software used by app developers and advertisers; service provider: runs campaigns and preload programs for carriers and device makers

geography_served.value: global: Operates worldwide, with major customers in North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: mobile advertising platform, app distribution and app monetization software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to brands, developers and carriers; partners / resellers: device makers and mobile carriers that preload apps on phones; online: self-serve advertising and developer platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR and CCPA govern user data used in ad targeting

notes: Business mix described from general knowledge and may have changed since my information was last updated.
